notes: Search results now tell you what to trust: every hit carries a real relevance score (0 to 1, comparable across searches) and a grounded verdict, instead of an opaque internal number.
Off-topic questions on gated recall now return nothing instead of confident filler, and a query whose words appear nowhere in your Kit can no longer surface a lookalike by coincidence.
Agents can ask for lean search results (fields: compact) and a query-level confidence report (include_meta) that names which of their words matched nothing.
Relevance scoring is now calibrated to the embedding model your Kit actually runs, so 'strong match' means the same thing on every Kit.
